recipe_origin: Existing explicit recipe generator in research/wash preparation source; these are authored test inputs, not recovered natural audio/exponent producers.
index_domain: i is zero-based integer 0 through 216 inclusive. Index applies to entire raw row before removing base bin.
zigzag24: q=floor(i/25); t=i%25; raw[i]=t if q%2==0 else 24-t
base_bin: raw[0] is part of formula, no override: mod25 base=3, zigzag24 base=0.
storage: 217 contiguous signed I16 words, little-endian, stride 2 bytes; 434 bytes total.
arithmetic: Exact nonnegative integer multiply then add then remainder; zigzag quotient/remainder then parity then subtraction. No floating point or rounding. For mod25 selected i*7+3 <=1515, no I16/I32 overflow. All outputs in 0..24.
phase: Both formulas reset index to zero at each row; no block offset, external level, implicit phase or prefix padding.
normalization_input_partition: Base raw[0] is separate scalar; groups consume raw[1..216], spans2 and4, counts108 and54. No tail padding needed in either case.
native_scope: Two controlled private-owner calls; ordinary full-band branch, option/gate from INPUTS. Source arrays and scratch are private allocations. Live business input untouched.
native_return: Low I16 return register is diagnostic only; not interpreted as a success/error contract. Output comparisons establish these two numeric cases.
